title: Measuring Faithful and Plausible Visual Grounding in VQA
reasoning: The terms 'faithful' and 'plausible' in the paper refer to technical properties of AI model explanations and visual grounding (i.e., how accurately an explanation reflects a model's internal decision-making process and how interpretable it is to humans). They do not relate to human religion, faith, morals, or ethics in a societal or philosophical sense.
